description: 1. The agent must read CLAUDE.md and pyproject.toml to detect 'Project context' (pyproject.toml exists), setting PLAN_ROOT to docs/plan/{trackId}/ with a date suffix. 2. The agent must auto-classify the task as 'Refactor' based on keywords in the description. 3. The agent must generate a valid Track ID in {shortname}_{YYYYMMDD} format and create docs/plan/{shortname}_{YYYYMMDD}/ directory. 4. The agent must scan for deploy infrastructure (finds Dockerfile and scripts/deploy.sh) and include a Deploy phase in plan.md. 5. spec.md must contain all required sections (Summary, Acceptance Criteria with 3-8 [ ] items, Dependencies, Out of Scope, Technical Notes) plus **Track ID** and **Type: Refactor** fields. 6. plan.md must use exact proprietary format: '## Phase N: Name' headers, '- [ ] Task N.Y: Description' task lines, 2-4 phases total, 5-15 total tasks, all tasks unchecked [ ], concrete file paths from codebase research (src/genomix/parsers/, etc.), a Deploy phase, last phase must be 'Docs & Cleanup', ## Overview section, ### Verification sections per phase, ## Final Verification section, and a reference to spec.md.
